event.channelDisabledDesc: Channel disabled automatically after consecutive failures hit the threshold
event.channelCooldownDesc: Platform rate limit triggered; channel paused from rotation
event.channelRecoveredDesc: Cooldown ended; channel back in rotation
event.sendFailedDesc: All channels tried but the message still failed to send
event.updateAvailableDesc: Checks for updates at startup and reminds you when a new version is found
event.bounceRateExceededDesc: Alerts when a channel's 7-day bounce rate exceeds the configured threshold
